import itertools

n = 4
solutions = []
for perm in itertools.permutations(range(n)):
    diffs = [abs(perm[i+1] - perm[i]) for i in range(n-1)]
    if sorted(diffs) == list(range(1, n)):
        solutions.append(list(perm))
        print(f"Perm: {perm}, Diffs: {diffs}")

print(f"\nTotal solutions: {len(solutions)}")
